question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Downloaded**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Downloaded** means copied data from one computer system to another, typically over the internet.

 
 
• **Example - ***He **downloaded** a photo from the internet to use as his own.*
 
 
 
• Here, in the given paragraph the word **'downloaded'** is used to explain **that all the papers and notes were copied from the internet**.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'downloaded'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Salander sat for a while (1) **__holding__** the telephone after Armansky hung up. She went to her work corner in the living room (2) **__and__** looked at the notes she had pinned up on the wall and the papers she had (3) **__stacked__** on the desk. What she had managed to collect was mostly press cuttings and articles **(4) __downloaded__** from the Internet. She took the papers and dropped (5) ______ in a desk drawer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cropped** means to cut or bite off the tops or ends. 
 
• **Uploaded** means transferred data from one computer to another, typically to one that is larger or remote from the user or functioning as a server.
 
• **Cut** means to divide into pieces with a knife or other sharp implement.
